from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path
import json, time
from scripts import weil_multi_prime_continuation_driver as driver
output = Path("computations/2026-10-01T215617Z-multi-prime-assembly-performance/data/phase7-target-screens.json")
rows = []
for dimension in (192, 196):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    result = driver._escalate_rigorous_screen(Fraction(11,20), dimension, [128], 32)
    rows.append({"dimension": dimension, "wall_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started, "result": result})
    print(f"N={dimension}: {result['status']}; assembly failures=" + str(sum(row.get('status') == 'assembly_failed' for row in result['attempts'])), flush=True)
payload = {"role": "phase7_component_smoke_not_qualification", "driver_version": driver.DRIVER_VERSION, "cache_version": driver.CACHE_VERSION, "source_fingerprint": driver._cache_source_fingerprint(), "support": "11/20", "precision_bits": 128, "residual_order": 32, "cache_used": False, "screens": rows}
output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
for row in rows:
    attempt=row['result']['attempts'][0]
    assert attempt['precision_status'] == driver.PRECISION_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT
    assert attempt['active_terms'] == [2,3]
    assert Fraction(attempt['mu_lower']) > 0
    assert Fraction(attempt['interval_widths']['GP_max']) > 0
    assert attempt.get('status') != 'assembly_failed'
print('Two real 128-bit target screens completed and serialized exact diagnostics; no qualification attempted.', flush=True)
